title: Ursula von der Leyen
gist: This is a World Economic Forum speaker biography page for Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission, listing her education and German political career. It contains no analysis or market-relevant claims.

insights.claim: Ursula von der Leyen is President of the European Commission and a Member of the Board of Trustees of the World Economic Forum.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Establishes her formal WEF tie; no market signal in the page itself.

insights.claim: Before leading the Commission, von der Leyen served as German Federal Minister for Family Affairs (2005-09), Labour and Social Affairs (2009-13) and Defence (listed as since 2013), and holds a medical doctorate and a master's in public health.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Background only: spans social policy, labour and defence portfolios, relevant to reading EU policy priorities.
